<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z ≈ 199, which likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈ 198 Da. Considering the isotopic pattern (≈ 9 % M+1 suggesting ~9 carbons, and a modest M+2 peak consistent with a single sulfur atom), the formula C₉H₁₀O₃S matches the observed mass within experimental error. Therefore the molecular formula is C9H10O3S.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O3S</final_answer>
